responsibility: Provides the low-level SPU intrinsic macro interface that maps C/C++ source names directly onto GCC target builtins for individual SPU instructions and related helper operations. It defines the qword/vector base type, conditional vector keyword compatibility, hundreds of si_* and spu_* instruction-like macros, special-register and channel access wrappers, and some always-inline composite helpers such as reciprocal estimates and DMA command setup, forming the implementation-oriented intrinsic layer beneath the more user-facing spu_intrinsics.h API.
